geometry_rule: Each coefficient starts at the same actual V0, preserving source IDs and multiplying the frozen original world-displacement payload by alpha.

metric.rule: Pooled integer RGB absolute error sum divided by sample count; report per-view errors and ratio to actual alpha0.
metric.selection: Minimum image error among technically available candidates, exact tie chooses smaller alpha.
metric.binding: Current geometry, proposal, reference/current PNG bytes, camera and renderer source identities

stage_v1.entrypoint: Actual calibration protocol client calling the reusable calibrator
stage_v1.execution: Six cold candidates, each actual sparse write/save, independent fresh read and three-view render using existing owned workers.
stage_v1.warm_reuse: Repeat identical requests after validating complete input/output identities, with zero new owned Blender jobs.

stage_v2.boundary: Only after all first-stage candidate/image/technical results, image choices and complete cost are fixed.
stage_v2.allowed_optimization: One owned-process batch per proposal, resetting to the same initial file before each candidate, then saving and freshly reopening for reading/rendering. Reference RGB reuse belongs to the same batch preparation change.
stage_v2.invariants: Alpha set, proposals, target images, sample count, metric, tie rule, actual native coordinates, camera, RGBA, image errors and selected coefficient.
stage_v2.adoption: Compare complete calibration wall/CPU/RSS, process versus logical operation counts and cold/warm costs. Retain first version if measured benefit is insufficient.

independent_scoring.order: Freeze actual image result and coefficient choice before loading private target coordinates or support labels.
independent_scoring.report: RMSE/p95/max, normal displacement, actual activity, exterior/native preservation, boundary/side-depth and complete scoped contacts.

technical_QA: Existing source/native topology, matrix, UV/material/scene and protected-coordinate preservation, operation/cumulative budget, finite coordinates, new degeneracy/reversal and full associated-domain contact comparison.

midpoint.role: Historical independent pre-registered alpha0.5 control. New entrypoint reproduces its saved arrays and image ordering and completes its technical/contact QA.

isolation: Calibration and image selection use current state, fixed proposals, matched reference PNGs/cameras and technical QA. Private geometry target and damaged labels are read only by the independent scorer after image freezing.
recovery: Persist candidate and operation state. Inspect completed owned artifacts and identity-bound receipts before resuming. Preserve operation IDs and read attempt counters.
accounting: Separate actual protocol clients, historical proposal-model generation, all current calibration work/failed attempts, nested worker operations, process resources and image decode/cache observations. Unmeasured fees and root/agent usage remain unknown.
conclusion_scope: One fixed development asset and two historical proposals at exactly three coefficients. Report failure within these sampled coefficients and independent target quality separately from image improvement.
completion: Fixed commit, complete local evidence and source references, one authorized planning callback, AL delivery and batch end for independent review.
